hybrid_identity._comment: Lab 30 (SC-300 1.4, 2.1). Feature support reflects Microsoft Learn's cloud sync vs Connect Sync comparison as understood in 2026; re-check the comparison table before relying on a single row.

concepts.password hash synchronization: A sign-in method where a hash of each user's on-premises password hash is copied to Microsoft Entra ID, so the cloud can check passwords on its own.
concepts.pass-through authentication: A sign-in method where Microsoft Entra ID hands each password check to lightweight agents on-premises, which ask Active Directory directly.
concepts.federation: A sign-in method where Microsoft Entra ID trusts a separate identity provider, such as AD FS, to authenticate users and send back a signed token.
concepts.Microsoft Entra Cloud Sync: A sync service run from the cloud that uses lightweight provisioning agents on-premises, suited to disconnected forests and simpler needs.
concepts.Microsoft Entra Connect Sync: The full on-premises sync server with the widest feature set, including pass-through authentication, federation set-up and device sync.
concepts.staged rollout: A way to move chosen groups of users from federated sign-in to cloud authentication before converting the whole domain.
concepts.duplicate attribute resiliency: The Microsoft Entra behaviour that quarantines a clashing UPN or proxy address on the newer object instead of failing the whole sync.
concepts.leaked credential detection: A Microsoft Entra ID Protection check that compares synced password hashes with credentials found in breach dumps, which needs password hash sync.
